no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting is necessary to evaluate effectiveness of the — formulations.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA 21-502 (Anthelios SX), an SPF 15 sunscreen lotion containing ecamsule, octocrylene, and avobenzone. The medical review explicitly states in its Advisory Committee Meeting section that no advisory committee meeting was necessary or planned for these NDAs. The only 'committee' referenced in the review documents is the internal FDA Executive Carcinogenicity Assessment Committee (CAC), which reviewed nonclinical tumor data and is not an advisory committee; it therefore produced no linkages to the approval.
